FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
CoolAir Solutions specializes in the sales, service, and installation of residential and light commercial heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) systems. Our operations encompass a comprehensive range of services including routine maintenance, emergency repairs, system installations, and energy-efficient upgrades. We are committed to employing only certified and licensed technicians, ensuring compliance with all local regulations and industry standards. Additionally, we maintain a robust safety program and documentation practices, along with training protocols to enhance the skills of our workforce. Our focus on customer satisfaction drives our approach, with a systematic follow-up process to address any client concerns promptly. We are dedicated to using environmentally friendly refrigerants and adhering to all EPA regulations regarding refrigerant handling.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in HVAC work in hazardous industrial facilities such as refineries, chemical plants, or power plants, and confirms that all technicians are fully licensed and certified for the scope of work performed. Additionally, we have had no more than three claims for general liability or workers' compensation in the past three years and do not perform asbestos abatement, mold remediation, or any environmental hazard work as a primary service.
